REQ-TEMP-001.description: Satellite temperature shall remain between -20°C and +60°C, inclusive.

REQ-BATTERY-001.description: Satellite battery voltage shall remain between 24 V and 32 V, inclusive.

REQ-SIGNAL-STRENGTH-001.description: Satellite signal strength shall remain above -90, inclusive.

REQ-COMM-001.description: Satellite communication status shall be OK.

REQ-SEQ-001.description: Satellite packet number shall increase by one unit.
